verdict.rationale: Highnote documents an integrated, unified ledger that tracks money movement and balances, with transactions posting the moment they occur rather than in end-of-day batches. It also cites reconciliation on the same core ledger as issuing, plus daily reconciliation and settlement run by its in-house operations team. However, the evidence never shows a ledger linking each authorization to its clearing record, or settlement reports that a finance lead can use to reconcile to the penny. missing for 10: documented authorization-to-clearing linkage, customer-facing settlement reporting, penny-level reconciliation reports or exports, independent or hands-on corroboration.
